subject: Analytics stack rightsize + renewal negotiation (Amplitude / Segment / Mixpanel)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Analytics stack rightsize + renewal negotiation (Amplitude / Segment / Mixpanel)

Team —

Quick heads-up: we have a cluster of analytics renewals coming up that intersect with both product analytics and API ingestion. Primary dates (from our tracker):
- Amplitude seat/plan renewal: 2027-01-31
- Segment (Event Ingestion) renewal: 2027-02-15
- Mixpanel annual plan review: 2027-03-01

Given spend and overlap (we're duplicating instrumentation in places), I want a short proposal for a rightsizing path that minimizes disruption for PM/Eng while delivering >=20% TCO reduction. Goals:
- Evaluate consolidation options (keep Segment + Amplitude, Segment + Mixpanel, or phased migration away from Segment)
- Identify migration risk, timeline, and estimated engineering hours
- Ask vendors for renewal/early-commit discount options + migration credits

Attached a short RFP/requirements doc — Analytics_Consolidation_RFP_2026.pdf — with event volumes and key integrations. Please each take an owner: Marissa on commercial + vendor discussions, Karthik on technical feasibility + implementation estimate, Monica on procurement/contract requirements, Laura for exec alignment.

Can we have a recommendation draft by EOD 2026-10-16?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachments: Analytics_Consolidation_RFP_2026.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Analytics stack rightsize + renewal negotiation (Amplitude / Segment / Mixpanel)

Stephanie — thanks for pulling this together. A few data points from infra/telemetry:
- Event volume: ~1.3B events/month ingested via Segment + ~450M additional server-side events that are duplicated into Amplitude and Mixpanel for funnels.
- Latency requirements: API analytics pipeline (real-time fraud signals) uses Segment + a lightweight enrichment layer; moving this is higher risk.
- Engineering estimate (very rough):
  - Phased migration off Segment (consumer-facing product analytics -> Mixpanel): 8–10 wks dedicated + 2 engineers (backend + infra) + 1 analytics engineer for schema work
  - Full decommission of Segment (including replays and OG mapping): 16–20 wks with additional edge cases

Cost buckets (current, approximate):
- Segment: $82k/year (ingestion + advanced features)
- Amplitude: $140k/year (active seats + advanced analytics)
- Mixpanel: $60k/year (projected)

My recommendation: seek renewal discounts but structure as a 2-phase plan — short-term renew Segment for ingestion (to avoid risk) while piloting Mixpanel for 2 high-value product flows. If pilot meets signal parity, negotiate migration credits and sunset Segment.

I can prepare a technical appendix for the proposal by Friday.

—Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@amplitude.com>, Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@segment.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji@mixpanel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RFP: Renewal + migration options for analytics stack (Redwood Inference)

Hi Claire / Samuel / Kenji —

Redwood is evaluating renewal terms and potential consolidation across Amplitude, Segment, and Mixpanel. Attached is a short RFP that outlines our volumes, integration matrix, and the timelines we're working towards (Analytics_Consolidation_RFP_2026.pdf).

What we'd like from each vendor by 2026-10-16:
- Renewal pricing for the upcoming term and any early-commit discounts you can offer
- Migration support options (credits, SOW ranges, estimated effort) if applicable
- Technical notes on data residency, SSO/SAML, and support SLAs
- Any references for prior migration engagements

Procurement and legal are CC'd. Please include any standard SOW/contract docs as attachments rather than links.

Thanks in advance — we'll review and schedule follow-ups as needed.

Best,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachments: Analytics_Consolidation_RFP_2026.pdf
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@amplitude.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Renewal + migration options for analytics stack (Redwood Inference)

Hi Stephanie / team —

Thanks for the RFP. Quick summary from Amplitude:
- Pricing: we can offer a 15% early-renewal discount if you commit to a 12-month term by 2026-11-15 and include a minimum seat/ingestion commitment.
- Migration support: we have a Migration Credit program — up to 250 engineering hours of migration assistance (applied as credits against your renewal) for qualifying migrations from other analytics providers (applies if you choose to migrate product analytics to Amplitude).
- Technical: we can meet EU/US data residency partitioning and support SAML + SCIM provisioning. SLA: 99.95% for data ingestion endpoints, priority support included in enterprise tier.
- Deliverables: sample SOW attached (Amplitude_Proposal_2026.pdf) with line items for onboarding, schema workshops, and replay services.

A few questions for clarity:
1) Which product flows are highest priority for pilot? (helps scope migration hours)
2) Are you expecting a full historical replay of events or a forward-only cutover?

Happy to hop on a call next week to walk through the proposal details — available Wed/Thu PT.

Best,
Claire Dawson
Head of Strategic Accounts, Amplitude
Claire.Dawson@amplitude.com

Attachments: Amplitude_Proposal_2026.pdf

From: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@segment.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Renewal + migration options for analytics stack (Redwood Inference)

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the RFP. From Segment's side: we recommend a staged approach that preserves Segment for ingestion and routing for at least one additional year while you run a Mixpanel pilot for product analytics. We can offer the following: 
- Commercial: 10% renewal discount for a 12-month upfront commitment.
- Migration support: engineering hours for data mapping and replay are available; we typically price SOWs for large replays but can offer a 50% credit on first 120 hours if you commit to an enterprise ingestion plan.
- Technical note: replays for historical events are non-trivial — expect transient costs (compute, S3 egress) and schema reconciliation.

Attached: Segment_Migration_SOW.docx with example scopes. Happy to set up a tech workshop with your infra team.

Regards,
Samuel Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Segment
sam.ortiz@segment.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Analytics stack rightsize + renewal negotiation (Amplitude / Segment / Mixpanel)

Thanks for the vendor responses and the internal analysis — good work. Recommendation from exec/ops: pursue a phased consolidation:
1) Near-term (renewal window): renew Segment for ingestion with a 12-month commit to avoid disruption for API analytics. Negotiate the 10% discount and push for the 50% migration credits in writing. Monica, please drive the contract ask.
2) Pilot: run a Mixpanel pilot (product analytics for two high-impact product flows) starting early Nov 2026. Marissa + Karthik to scope the pilot; target is to validate signal parity and dashboard parity within 8 weeks.
3) If pilot passes: use Amplitude and Mixpanel commercial proposals to negotiate migration credits/discounts and decide whether to: a) consolidate product analytics into Amplitude or Mixpanel fully, or b) split responsibilities (Mixpanel for real-time funnels, Amplitude for exploratory analytics).

Deliverables & owners:
- Monica: get draft SOW/contract redlines from Segment + request the migration credits in writing (due 2026-10-22)
- Marissa: coordinate vendor pilot terms and pricing negotiations (due 2026-10-22)
- Karthik: finalize technical appendix and pilot success criteria (due 2026-10-20)

We want to avoid a hard cutover risk during Q1 2027; this phased plan keeps us flexible and aims for >=20% TCO reduction by mid-2027.

I'll inform finance and schedule a 30-min vendor sync next week.

—Laura
VP, Product Operations
